title: Rocket Lab Unveils 'GHOST,' a Game-Changing New Portable Launch System That Can Carry Payloads to Orbit from Anywhere on Earth
title_norm: rocket lab unveils ghost a game changing new portable launch system that can carry payloads to orbit from anywhere on earth
snippet: Private space launch services company Rocket Lab has unveiled its GHOST (Global Hypersonic & Orbital Spaceport Technology) self-contained mobile launch system, capable of placing payloads in orbit or enabling suborbital launches from virtually anywhere on Earth .
